Header: Bemisia tabaci Sinhala: Sudu Massa; Tamil: Ven ee

Prevention: Destruction of crop residues after harvest
Avoid crop establishment in high temperatures and high
RH Establish vigorous crop by using recommended fertilizer rates with organic matter
Conserve natural vegetation to encourage natural enemies like lace wings, spiders, lady beetles
Synchronised planting and seed treatment (see direct control)
Monitoring: Whitefly populations increase during dry weather conditions
Observe lower surface of leaf for nymphs and whitefly adults
Observe light yellow colour patches on the leaves
Apply synthetic chemicals when population exceed 5-6 whiteflies/plant
Honeydew and associated sooty moulds can be seen
Look out for leaf curling, yellowing mosaics or yellowing veins
Direct Control: Water spray to reduce the population build up
Use yellow sticky traps and water trays to reduce pest population
Restrictions: WHO but considered to be moderately hazardous.
Do not apply at the flowering stage.
Maximum number of sprays per season – not more than two
Apply from flowering stage if infestation is seen and repeat at fortnightly intervals, if necessary.
